about: The Audio Output (302M)'s sink end as its mixer arm builds it (AudioOutput302mModule.buildPipeline, a stereo device's default range), from its render tap on; %SINK% stands for `pulsesink name=sink device=<device>` and its stream-properties are left off. AudioOutput302mModule.test.ts holds the module's string to it; gst_302m_late_feed_test.py runs it into mrtestaudiosink (B-249; Phase 4's string since M6).
